question: Two circular loops $A$ and $B$ are placed coaxially with their planes parallel and close to each other. Loop $A$ is connected to a source such that it carries a current $I(t)$ increasing with time. Loop $B$ is a closed conducting loop (total resistance $R$) and is free to move only along the common axis (no rotation). Neglect any external magnetic fields. Analyze the force exerted by loop $A$ on loop $B$ at the instant when $\dfrac{dI}{dt} > 0$.

options.C: There is no force between them.
options.D: Loop A applies a torque on Loop B causing it to rotate.
